headline: Weathered Expanse Recast; Nevish Line Shifts Under Heavy Fire
war_summary:
Fighting in the Weathered Expanse has recast that sector since the last edition. Where it stood five works Colonial, one Warden and three unclaimed, it now returns three Warden, one Colonial and five reduced to no-man's-land, with fifty-six actions in the past day, five of them in the last two hours and the latest entered at this packet's cutoff; casualties there stand near eight thousand a side for the day.

The Nevish Line has also moved: its unclaimed work now flies Colonial, leaving six Colonial works to two Warden, with forty-six actions in the day and four in the past two hours. Linn Mercy holds at three Warden works, seven Colonial and one unclaimed, its firing cooled from the day's peak but still the heaviest anywhere at thirty-seven actions in twenty-four hours. Callahan's Passage keeps all ten works Warden amid fresh work at Crumbling Post. Mooring County stands eleven Warden to one Colonial, Marban Hollow four Warden, three Colonial and one unclaimed, and Stonecradle eight Colonial to one Warden, quiet since yesterday evening. Across the map, Colonial holdings remain the greater.
